thread:
rui-chen: Hi payroll team  my Feb 28 paystub shows both Singapore CPF and UK PAYE deductions for the same salary payment. I relocated to London on 2026-02-15 and expected only UK withholding. Net is much lower.
apac-payroll: Sorry @rui-chen. Can you DM a redacted screenshot of the stub?
rui-chen: Pasted redacted lines below: 
```
Period: 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28
Gross: 5,600.00 SGD
CPF Employee: -840.00 SGD
CPF Employer: -1,050.00 SGD (employer line)
UK PAYE: -720.00 GBP
Employee pension: -56.00 GBP
Net paid: x,xxx.xx (converted)
```
europe-payroll: Thanks. It looks like payroll exports for the February run included both the SG resident row (full month) and a new UK starter row because HR created the UK hire before we suppressed the SG export. That produced dual statutory deductions.
hr-relocations: Relocation event submitted on 2026-02-10; Workday location changed to UK on 2026-02-13. I see a note that CPF cessation paperwork was submitted but the SG payroll termination flag didn't get an effective date until Feb 20 due to a manual step stuck in the queue.
payroll-bot: Ticket created: PR-31415 "Duplicate CPF + PAYE on rui-chen Feb 2026". Assigned to GlobalPay ops. ETA: provider ack 48 hrs.
finance-ops: If this is true we should consider a one-time net top-up while refunds process. Please quantify the shortfall and add an estimated gross-up so we can approve.
apac-payroll: Estimated shortfall ~900 SGD after FX. Operational plan: 1) request SG provider to reverse employee CPF for post-termination days, 2) request UK provider to confirm PAYE reporting and, if needed, amend submission, 3) post correcting lines on March payroll showing reversal + net make-whole, 4) document impacts for IR8A/UK P60 equivalents.
tax-advisor: Note on CPF: employer/employee CPF is statutory; employer portion is not employee withholding but can be misposted. We'll need to correct employer lines separately. For treaty/residency: because relocation date is mid-month, we must determine effective tax residency for the period; corrections will be reflected on year-end forms. Keep all stubs and the relocation paperwork.
rui-chen: Will this affect my equity vest that paid out Feb 20? I had an RSU tranche paid that day and the stub for that payout shows PAYE but also CPF on the overall period. Concerned about double withholding on the RSU payout.
europe-payroll: Good catch. Equity payouts are taxed at source in the country of payroll. If the RSU was included in the SG run and also in a UK payroll row, we might have duplicate withholding on the same gross. We'll audit the equity payout lines specifically.
apac-payroll: Operational next steps: pause any recurring UK pension deductions until we confirm final residency flags; open an equity payout audit for the Feb run; request SG to reverse any employee CPF incorrectly applied to the equity component.
payroll-bot: PR-31415 updated: equity audit sub-ticket PR-31415-1 created.
finance-ops: Approving provisional one-time net relief up to 1,200 SGD pending provider confirmation. Please mark as "relocation relief" on March payroll if used.
rui-chen: Appreciate it. Any ETA on when corrected stub will be available?
apac-payroll: We'll try to get provider ack within 48 hrs and aim to post reversals on the March payroll. If provider delays, we'll still issue the net make-whole on March 15 to avoid hardship, then reconcile later.
tax-advisor: Final note: corrections will flow through year-end reporting; you may receive updated P60/IR8A equivalents. We'll provide a reconciliation pack for your tax advisor.
hr-relocations: I'll also add a pre-payroll "termination confirmed" gate to the relocation checklist so this doesn't recur for mid-month moves.
rui-chen: Thanks team. Please attach the corrected stub and any provider ticket numbers here when available. :pray:
